source_authority.document: Ten Advances in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
loci: Chapter 9 defines R_k(3) as the least N for which every k-edge-colouring of K_N has a monochromatic triangle.
Theorem 1.1 states that some absolute c>0 satisfies R_k(3)>=(c*k^(1/3)/log k)^k for every integer k>=2; the manuscript does not specify c=1/(6e^38) and says absolute constants are not optimized.
Theorem 1.1 with the factorial upper bound gives k^((1/3-o(1))*k)<=R_k(3)<=k^((1+o(1))*k) and R_k(3)=k^{Theta(k)}; all Chapter 9 logarithms are natural.

definition_concordance.colouring: TriangleFree quantifies over every colour in Fin k and requires each colour graph CliqueFree 3, exactly encoding absence of a monochromatic triangle in a k-edge-colouring of a complete graph.
definition_concordance.ramsey_number: ForcesMonochromaticTriangle n k quantifies over all TopEdgeLabelings of Fin n by Fin k; triangleRamseyNumber k is Nat.sInf of the forcing set. exists_forcesMonochromaticTriangle proves the set nonempty and triangleRamseyNumber_forces proves the sInf is itself forcing, while triangleFree_lt_triangleRamseyNumber proves every triangle-free witness has smaller order. This realizes the source least-N convention.
definition_concordance.logarithms: The Chapter 9 manuscript states all logarithms are natural; the configured logarithmic targets use Real.log, so no log-base transport is hidden.
definition_concordance.explicit_constant: The manuscript leaves c unspecified. The solution independently proves quantitativeLowerBound_explicit_all with c=1/(6*exp 38), using a large-k palette-stage argument and quantitativeLowerBound_explicit_small for the finite residual k<342 range.
definition_concordance.asymptotics: The epsilonized log coefficient target is the natural-log form of the printed exponents 1/3-o(1) and 1+o(1); the Filter Theta target is the logarithmic reformulation of R_k(3)=k^{Theta(k)}.

target_audits.source_relation: The printed k^((1/3-o(1))*k)<=R_k(3)<=k^((1+o(1))*k) is equivalent to eventual natural-log coefficients between 1/3-epsilon and 1+epsilon for every epsilon>0.
target_audits.formal_relation: The solution derives the lower logarithmic side from quantitativeLowerBound_explicit_all and the upper side from triangleRamseyNumber_factorial_upper, with eventual positivity used before applying Real.log.

target_audits.source_relation: The manuscript prints R_k(3)=k^{Theta(k)}; taking natural logarithms yields log R_k(3)=Theta(k log k).
target_audits.formal_relation: The target states exactly Filter-level asymptotic equivalence of log(triangleRamseyNumber k) with k*log k, proved from explicit eventual two-sided logarithmic bounds.

evidence: The source/formal lower-bound domain k>=2 is inhabited, for example k=2.
exists_forcesMonochromaticTriangle k constructs a forcing order for every k, so the Nat.sInf defining triangleRamseyNumber is over a nonempty set.
triangleRamseyNumber_forces proves the selected sInf actually has the forcing property, closing least-N normalization rather than relying on a bare infimum definition.
triangleFree_lt_triangleRamseyNumber supplies the complementary witness direction; in the small-k lower-bound proof an empty-vertex triangle-free colouring gives 0<triangleRamseyNumber k.
The eventual and atTop targets range over an infinite natural-number filter and the solution establishes positive Ramsey values before taking logarithms or k-th roots.

quantitativeLowerBound_explicit_all uses the palette-stage (H/exp 38)^k bound for large k and quantitativeLowerBound_explicit_small for k<342.

disposition.basis: All four targets match Chapter 9 at the declared boundary. The explicit 1/(6e^38) lower bound is admitted only as a formally proved strengthening of the source's unspecified-c theorem; divergence, epsilonized logarithmic coefficients, and logarithmic Theta are source-faithful projections or reformulations. The least-Ramsey-number and logarithm conventions are aligned and the relevant domains are nonvacuous.
